run_AlphaSearch: run the AlphaSearch algorithm to estimate best alphas and validate through rollout
draw_alphas: draw alpha coefficients for a given number of anchors using Dirichlet or simplex sampling
remove_anchor: remove the last anchor from a model's LinearSubspace modules and decrement n_anchors
review_AlphaSearch_run: review the AlphaSearch run method that estimates best alphas in current and former subspaces
refactor_draw_alphas: refactor the draw_alphas function to support additional anchor count strategies beyond four
